datasets.title: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the_democratic_republic_of_the_congo_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across DRC administrative areas to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Classification data were spatially referenced and compiled into monthly geographic datasets for 2021, representing medium-term projections of food insecurity phases.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas
